pr_body:
Let's support enumerating over devices that match all of the given
properties instead of any of the given properties by adding a new
function sd_device_enumerator_add_match_property_required() which
specifies properties that should all be matched instead of just one.

Fixes https://github.com/systemd/systemd/issues/28372
pr_comments:
hmm, is this really the ideal semantics? 

maybe add a sd_device_enumerator_add_match_property_mandatory() or sd_device_enumerator_add_match_property_strict() or sd_device_enumerator_add_match_property_required() or so which is just like sd_device_enumerator_add_match_property() but any property specified that way must be fulfilled rather than is an option.

issue_context.title: sd-device enumerator should support matching against all specified properties instead of any property
issue_context.body:
### Component

_No response_

### Is your feature request related to a problem? Please describe

Currently, `sd_device_add_match_property()` matches against devices with any of the configured property matches. I would like to match against all of the configured property matches.

### Describe the solution you'd like

An API to match against all of the configured property matches. With extra effort, we could go even further and implement the same API as sd-journal which allows combining OR and AND clauses in its matches. For my use case, being able to switch to AND instead of OR would be sufficient though.
